title.zh: 每个结论用的是哪一份数据

lead.en: The working data release is R071 and the label snapshot is A7.2. Map v2 was frozen on 24 October 2026. Field statistics use first-publication dates through 30 September 2026; opportunity searches can include later work and report their search dates separately. This review copy does not update.
lead.zh: 工作数据版本为 R071，标签快照为 A7.2。地图 v2 于 2026 年 10 月 24 日冻结。领域统计使用截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的首次公开日期；机会检索可以包含之后的工作，并单独报告检索日期。本评审版不再更新。

note.en: The 99 system-level defences and 42 AgentDojo papers overlap in 29 works. The map and content tables differ by two works whose placeholder dates were replaced by arXiv first-version dates after the map was frozen; the former population is used for theme and cluster statements, the latter for problem-line and endpoint statements. A larger platform total is not a field-statistics denominator.
note.zh: 99 个系统级防御与 42 篇 AgentDojo 论文有 29 篇重合。地图与内容表相差两篇：它们的占位日期在地图冻结后被替换为 arXiv 首版日期；前者用于主题与星团结论，后者用于主线与终点结论。平台累计收录量不是领域统计的分母。

p.en: One correction concerns Prompt Injection in Automated Resume Screening, whose frozen-map record used the year-only placeholder date 31 December 2026; the content and experimental-use records use its arXiv first version, 25 June 2026. The January–September 2026 ranking denominator is therefore 3,436 works (including 180 unassigned) and the content and use denominator 3,437 (181 unassigned); for 2026 H1 they are 2,031 and 2,032. All 14 theme counts agree across the two exports.
p.zh: 其中一处修正涉及 Prompt Injection in Automated Resume Screening：冻结地图中它用的是仅有年份的占位日期 2026 年 12 月 31 日，内容与实验使用记录用的是 arXiv 首版日期 2026 年 6 月 25 日。因此 2026 年 1–9 月的排名分母为 3,436 篇（含 180 篇未归类），内容与使用分母为 3,437 篇（181 篇未归类）；2026 上半年分别为 2,031 和 2,032。14 个主题的计数在两份导出中一致。

p.en: Retrospective reconstruction. The quarterly maps start in December 2023; the annual visualisation uses final-map coordinates and the colour assignment of Figure 2 is retrospective. Some original reference lists were obtained from later paper versions, so historical maps interpret historical structure rather than claim what an analyst could have discovered at each cutoff.
p.zh: 回顾性重建。季度地图从 2023 年 12 月开始；年度可视化使用最终地图坐标，图 2 的颜色分配也是回顾性的。部分原始参考文献来自论文的后续版本，因此历史地图用于解释历史结构，而不是声称分析者在每个截点当时就能发现这些结构。
